niche: paediatric toxicovigilance at a regional poison data network: which watched over-the-counter product's 2024-25 packaging change raised accidental exposures of children under six above what its packs would have produced unchanged, when the packs a child can reach are the ones its past sales left in household cupboards
answer: Refer Feverkind Junior Strength Acetaminophen Oral Suspension: effect 1.3, the only change at 1.20 or more; runner-up Embercalm Nicotine Polacrilex Lozenge Mint 1.1, gap 0.2

analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans the enquiry records and the four-weekly sales and reads the review procedure correctly sets each watched product's accidental under-six exposures in the twelve months after its packaging change against the twelve months before per 100,000 packs sold, and refers the product whose rate rose most, a product whose sales fell after its change while the packs already in cupboards kept producing exposures, not the product whose new cap made each pack in a home riskier but also lifted its sales.

world.geography: United States (a regional poison data network across fifteen Midwest, Plains and Great Lakes states; all organisations, products and people invented)
world.org_type: a regional poison data network pooling its member poison centers' case records, referring to an invented federal packaging review office

driver: Each unit's events come from a stock that its past inflows built and that drains at the unit's own pace, so a change's effect has to be read against the events that stock would have produced, recovered from the unit's own record before the change, because a rate on the current inflow credits a change with every move of the inflow.
driver_concrete: Each watched medicine's accidental under-six exposures in the twelve months after its packaging change are set against the exposures its packs in homes would have produced unchanged, a stock its past sales built that drains at the product's own pace and that only the product's own exposure record before the change pins, because a rate on the year's packs sold rises for a product whose sales fell while its old packs stayed in cupboards and stays flat for a product whose new packaging lifted both its sales and its per-pack risk.
stump: The default path divides each product's accidental under-six exposures by its packs sold, compares the twelve months after its packaging change with the twelve before and refers the product whose sales fell after its change, while the product whose new cap made each pack in a home riskier shows a flat rate because the same cap also lifted its sales.

differentiation.task270: task270 v6 reads where an item sold without a fixed slot actually landed, a placement recovered by joining a sales record to a landing record; this build has no slot and no placement, and its decisive move rebuilds the packs a product's past sales left in household cupboards, which drain at the product's own pace, as the exposure base a packaging change's effect is read against.
differentiation.task245: task245 rebuilds periods a recorder lost, non-randomly, from a shared driver and the recorder's own response to it; this build has no missing periods, every exposure is recorded, and its decisive move is the at-risk stock behind complete counts, built from the product's sales history and its own depletion, against which a packaging change's effect is read.
differentiation.task199: task199 reads a media-sourced event count against the observation effort that produced it, a detection base; this build has no detection layer (every exposure is recorded by the member centers) and reads each product's exposure count against the stock at risk that its own past purchases built and that drains at its own fitted pace.

lineage.niche: the frequency containment reserve portfolio of an independent flexibility aggregator: which contracted site's primary response is genuinely short of its contracted droop rather than measured short because its own market-block ramp moved its output in the same seconds
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a unit's own response to a shared signal, measured over seconds in which the unit's output is also moving along a scheduled trajectory that the records give only as its endpoints, and because the shared signal deviates systematically at exactly the moments those trajectories run, taking the output change over the episode, or its change from the scheduled endpoint, measures response plus trajectory and ranks the units by the direction their trajectories happened to run rather than by the response they owed.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each contracted site's delivered droop response has to be measured against its own market-block ramp trajectory, recovered from the boundaries where no qualifying deviation occurred, because deterministic frequency deviations fall at the same quarter-hour boundaries at which every site is ramping to a new schedule, so a response taken as output minus the pre-event level, or minus the block setpoint, credits the sites that happened to be ramping up and penalises the sites that happened to be ramping down.
lineage.stump: The default path measures each site's response as its output change from the second before each qualifying deviation (or from the block's scheduled setpoint), divides by the deviation to get MW per hertz, compares that with the contracted droop and files the site whose qualifying deviations mostly fell on boundaries where it was ramping down, while the site whose droop is genuinely about three-quarters of contract sits mid-table because its deviations fell on boundaries where it was ramping up.

world.org_type: independent flexibility aggregator running a portfolio of grid-scale batteries and gas-engine sites into the system operator's frequency containment reserve market

lineage.answer: VKF-KPV Kampvliet, 72 per cent of contracted gain
